title: Kapow Salt E-liquid – Classic 30ml
description:
Description
Crack open a fresh can of this fizzy goodness. Sweet, bubbly, and full of flavour, this cola will “POP” on your tastebuds!
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Kapow is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
